name: Kang Variants
description: Multiple versions of Kang from across the timestream converge on the present, each pursuing their own agenda. Immortus, Rama-Tut, the Scarlet Centurion—when Kang fights Kang, every timeline is at risk.
flavorText: There is always another Kang. There is always another war.
musicAIPrompt: Create a 45-second seamless loopable orchestral film score in the exact style of John Williams. Mystery / Revelation. Multiversal Kang civil war with overlapping variants. Fractured overlapping Kang motifs. Disorienting and epic, wide stereo, instrumental only, perfectly loopable with no fade in/out.
